tour_welcome_body: Every letter becomes a strategy here. In under a minute, you will learn about the modes, your progress, and where to customize the experience.
tour_profile_body: Your profile shows your level, XP, and prestige. Form words, complete matches, and follow your progress on this bar.
tour_play_body: Play includes Classic, Themed, Hardcore, Flashcards, and Versus. Each mode trains your vocabulary in a different way.
tour_settings_body: Change the color palette, adjust music and effects, choose a Lettering Radio track, and enable fullscreen.
tour_language_body: Use the flags to change the interface language. The game words will keep helping you practice English.
tour_ready_body: Choose a letter from the piece, place it on the board, and connect letters to form words. The Help button opens this tour again.
tour_modes_welcome_title: Choose how you want to learn
tour_modes_welcome_body: This screen brings all game modes together. Choose a mode first, adjust its available options, and then start the match.
tour_modes_select_body: Open Modes to choose Classic, Themed, Hardcore, Versus, or Flashcards. The description explains the goal of each option.
tour_modes_start_body: This button always shows the current mode. After choosing, use it to prepare and open the match.
tour_modes_learning_title: Theme and goal in Themed mode
tour_modes_learning_body: In Themed mode, choose a category and a word goal. These options appear before the match starts.
tour_modes_ranking_body: The ranking shows the best results for the selected mode. You need to sign in to participate.
tour_game_letters_body: Each round offers four letters. Click or tap the letter you want to place before it reaches the bottom of the board.
tour_game_board_body: On a computer, use A and D to move, S to drop, and Q to switch letters. On mobile, tap, drag, and hold on the board.
tour_game_words_body: These words guide upcoming letters. Form words horizontally or vertically and confirm them when they are highlighted.
tour_game_powers_body: Combos and words unlock powers. Use them to clear parts of the board when you need more space.
tour_game_history_body: Confirmed words, score, and goal progress are recorded here during the match.
tour_game_pause_body: Open pause to stop the match, start again, or return to mode selection.
tour_versus_quick_body: Quick Match automatically searches for another online player and starts when both players are ready.
tour_versus_room_body: Create a room to receive a code and send it to a friend. The match starts when they join.
tour_versus_join_body: Enter the code shared by the host and choose Join Room to enter the private match.
tour_cards_overview_body: The dashboard summarizes your decks, words, and due reviews so you can decide what to study first.
tour_cards_create_body: Use the tabs to access your decks or create a new one. Each deck groups related words and translations.
tour_cards_study_body: Open a deck to manage words or start a review. Your rating decides when each card returns.
tour_cards_community_body: Browse decks published by other players and add a copy to your collection to study.
